entities.summary: Lupus-TR-3b is an extrasolar planet orbiting the star Lupus-TR-3. The planet was discovered in 2007 by personnel from the Center for Astrophysics | Harvard & Smithsonian observing at the Siding Spring Observatory in Australia, by the transit method.
